draft.shortGloss: to speak; to talk; to say

notes: Imperfective. In the sense 'to speak / talk', the perfective is поговорить ('to have a talk'). In the sense 'to say / tell', the perfective is сказать.
With languages, use the adverb with по-: говорить по-русски ('to speak Russian').
